field.label: Enabled
field.help: Turn this rule on or off without removing it.

field.label: Hostname
field.help: Public hostname Cloudflare serves for this origin, such as app.example.com.

field.label: Service Type
field.help: Protocol the origin service speaks, such as HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, SSH, or RDP.

field.label: Origin URL
field.help: Local address cloudflared connects to for this rule, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080 or tcp://127.0.0.1:22.
